messages:
Sophie: ran hf->redwood conversion for starling-7b-chat and smoke tests are failing. tokenization drift + KV errors on long convo :bug:

Raj: can you paste the original HF config.json and the converted one?

Sophie: original snippet:
```
"max_position_embeddings": 2048,
"rope_scaling": null,
"sliding_window": false,
"num_key_value_heads": 32
```
converted shows:
```
"max_position_embeddings": 1024,
"rope_scaling": {"factor":0.8},
"sliding_window": true,
"num_key_value_heads": 16
```

Kevin: that explains it — truncation + altered rotary scaling will change attention magnitude, sliding_window flips KV eviction semantics, and the head count mismatch breaks KV layout.

Maria: also noticed the chat template lost the `<|special_user|>` token mapping, converter replaced it with `` — prompts tokenize differently now.

Sophie: observed failures: (1) generation BLEU down ~6% in quick eval, (2) serving logs show "KV cache head dimension mismatch" on >1k token convos, (3) replies truncated at 1024 tokens.

Raj: head mismatch likely from converter heuristics detecting combined KV layout and halving heads. Converter should preserve explicit `num_key_value_heads` when present. We might be misdetecting kv layout.

Kevin: for rope_scaling: HF sometimes stores training-vs-inference scaling. If converter auto-applies factor 0.8 we may be double-scaling. Quick test: set rope_scaling to null in converted config and re-run.

Maria: sliding_window=true means runtime uses rolling KV windows and remaps positional indexing — that plus max_pos 1024 explains prefix eviction and truncation.

Sophie: quick repro command:
```
python smoke_onboard.py --model starling-7b-chat --prompt-file tests/long_chat.txt
```
error snippet:
```
RuntimeError: KV cache shape mismatch (expected 32, got 16) at encoder/attn
```

conversion-bot: conversion job 2390000115 completed. warnings: detected combined_kv_heads layout, auto-set num_key_value_heads=16. Override with `--force-num-kv-heads` if incorrect.

Raj: proposed fixes:
- converter: preserve explicit `num_key_value_heads` and don't downcast if HF sets it
- converter: don't toggle `sliding_window` unless HF explicitly sets it
- runtime: add clearer KV-shape mismatch hints and a preflight that compares HF vs Redwood config fields

Kevin: immediate workaround: re-run converter with `--force-num-kv-heads 32 --preserve-rope-scaling --sliding-window false`. Also hold q8 quant rollout until parity confirmed — quant can amplify mismatches.

Sophie: re-run queued with those flags. also running nll/perplexity A/B to isolate rope_scaling effect. Token diff: converter lost `<|special_user|>` -> replaced by `` which offsets token ids in chat templates.

Maria: I'll add a unit in tests/onboard that roundtrips additional_special_tokens -> chat_template placeholders. That should catch this mapping.

Kevin: I'll open a PR for the converter adjustments and add a CI preflight job to diff HF config -> converted config fields (rope_scaling, sliding_window, num_key_value_heads, max_position_embeddings). tagging you all. :eyes:

Sophie: smoke passed after forcing flags (no KV errors, truncation fixed). Eval still ~1% BLEU lower; suspect rope_scaling. Holding dedicated rollout; model remains in staging.

Raj: action items (short):
- converter: explicit preservation of num_key_value_heads & sliding_window default to source
- runtime: improved KV mismatch diagnostics + fail-fast preflight check
- dextools: add config diff preflight report
- QA: full eval suite before quant rollout

conversion-bot: note: canary for starling-7b-chat postponed until 2024-11-02.

Maria: ping for pair-review on the test change.

Sophie: will review, thanks :thumbsup:
